faq.q: What products look good in a cinematic video?
faq.a: Products with a clear shape or finish, including speakers, bottles, lamps, watches and sunglasses, suit a slow reveal.

faq.q: Does the clip come with music?
faq.a: No. AIVideosUGC does not add a music track or captions; add licensed audio in your editor after download.

faq.q: Can I show my logo in the scene?
faq.a: Your own logo in the uploaded product photo is fine. Another company’s logo or trademark may be rejected.

faq.q: What video size suits a cinematic product video?
faq.a: Use 16:9 for a website or YouTube placement and 9:16 for TikTok, Reels and other mobile feeds.

faq.q: How much does a cinematic clip cost?
faq.a: A 6-second clip costs 24 credits, 10 seconds costs 40, 15 seconds costs 60 and 30 seconds costs 120.

faq.q: Can the video add moody lighting to a plain photo?
faq.a: Yes. The generated scene can add moody light and a slow camera move; review the product outline and color frame by frame.

faq.q: Can I use a cinematic clip in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Clips can run in your own paid campaigns, website heroes and social posts, with no watermark.

faq.q: Do I need a film crew or studio for this look?
faq.a: No. The set, lighting and camera move are generated from one photo, without a crew or rental day.

steps.sourceAlt: Compact black speaker photographed alone on a dark display plinth.
steps.sourceHint: Keep the product silhouette crisp against its background.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. On a dark sideboard beside a tall window, a compact black speaker catches one cool highlight as the camera makes a slow push-in. Keep the woven grille and rounded silhouette centered. End with the speaker still in the pool of light. Sound: quiet room tone; no music.
steps.resultAlt: Rounded pebble-shaped black speaker catches a cool cinematic highlight on a dark sideboard.
